# Perlego

> > Perlego is an online subscription service providing unlimited access to academic books and textbooks with Smart Search and research tools for students and researchers.

Perlego offers a digital library of academic ebooks spanning business, science, technology, and humanities, serving students at institutions like Hult University across the UK, South Africa, and globally. The platform features Smart Search technology and study tools designed to enhance online learning and research.

## Key Topics

- Academic ebooks and textbooks
- Smart Search technology
- Digital library subscription
- Online learning platform
- Research assistant tools
- Student resources
- Business and management
- Science and engineering
- Career development
- Workplace skills
- Professional development
- University partnerships
- Study tools and annotations
- Unlimited book access

## Platform Overview

- [Perlego | An online subscription for all your academic books](https://www.perlego.com/): Homepage for Perlego's academic ebook subscription service with Smart Search

## Business & Management

- [[PDF] It's Okay to Manage Your Boss by Bruce Tulgan](https://www.perlego.com/book/1009310/its-okay-to-manage-your-boss-the-stepbystep-program-for-making-the-best-of-your-most-important-relationship-at-work-pdf): Bruce Tulgan's guide on managing up, published by Jossey-Bass
- [[PDF] Scale and Scope by Alfred D. Chandler Jr.](https://www.perlego.com/book/1133135/scale-and-scope-the-dynamics-of-industrial-capitalism-pdf): Chandler's Pulitzer Prize-winning work on industrial capitalism

## Science & Technology

- [[PDF] Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics by Robert J. Hardy](https://www.perlego.com/book/1000010/thermodynamics-and-statistical-mechanics-an-integrated-approach-pdf): Robert J. Hardy's textbook on thermodynamics, published by Wiley
- [[PDF] Reinforcement Learning Algorithms with Python by Andrea Lonza](https://www.perlego.com/book/1204150/reinforcement-learning-algorithms-with-python-learn-understand-and-develop-smart-algorithms-for-addressing-ai-challenges-pdf): Andrea Lonza's guide to RL algorithms using Python & TensorFlow

## Education & Teaching

- [[PDF] Teaching Discipline & Self-Respect by SiriNam S. Khalsa](https://www.perlego.com/book/1004177/teaching-discipline-selfrespect-effective-strategies-anecdotes-and-lessons-for-successful-classroom-management-pdf): Khalsa's classroom management strategies, published by Corwin
